findings.claim: high-severity dep advisory: nanoid <3.3.18 (transitive via next)
findings.evidence: npm audit 2026-08-14 reports 1 high: GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8, node_modules/nanoid, fixAvailable true.

findings.claim: Dependency drift: eslint-config-next 16.2.10->16.3.1, react/react-dom 19.2.4->19.2.8, next 16.3.0->16.3.1, and @types/node 20.19.43->26.2.0 are available minor/patch/major bumps not yet applied; eslint 9.39.5->10.8.1 and typescript 5.9.3->7.0.2 majors are blocked by upstream peer ranges (eslint-plugin-react eslint<=9.7, typescript-eslint typescript<6.1.0)
findings.evidence: Re-confirmed 2026-08-14 `npm outdated`, unchanged from the 2026-08-10 pass. `npm audit` clean of vulnerabilities from these specific packages.
findings.fix: Bump eslint-config-next, next, and react/react-dom (safe patch/minor). Evaluate typescript ->~6.0.x under the same ceiling that worked for sibling repos. Hold eslint at 9.x until eslint-config-next ships an eslint-10-compatible eslint-plugin-react.
